name: fix114_kapdun_stone
verifies: fix-114: world items on furniture are focusable and can be taken. G3's furniture collision shapes are coarse volumes (Kap Dun shed: G3_Object_Shelf_01 is one Box shape and the teleport stone It_Teleport_KapDun (world item f63af0e3) lies inside it), so the focus ray (fix-104) must not count the solid shape an item lies on or in as a blocker (FocusSight.HoldsItem). Test shelf: an item inside a solid test box is focused; a wall between hero and item still blocks. Then the real stone in Kap Dun is focused and taken.
